name: ClawsGO Science
summary: AI research agent with a cloud lab that searches literature, runs code and drafts cited papers.
description: ClawsGO Science is an end-to-end scientific research agent: from a question it searches academic sources, analyzes data, writes/runs code on a cloud host (or connected lab GPU), and delivers reports, LaTeX drafts and figures. Differentiator is unattended multi-hour cloud runs with a replayable trace and AI-native LaTeX workbench. Free tier includes 1,500 permanent signup credits; Plus $9.9/month, Pro $29.9/month, Max $99.9/month, Ultra $299.9/month (verified on official pricing page).
features: Data analysis and code execution on a cloud host or connected lab GPU
Multi-hour unattended runs with replayable trace
